title: Doubling time vs generation (per seed)
caption: Gen-1 doubling ~43 min in band; gen-2 inflated by the emit-window cap.
interpretation: Per-generation doubling time from the emitted global_time span: gen-1 ~43 min (in band for the glucose condition), gen-2 ~63 min. The gen-2 inflation is an emit-window-cap artifact (gen-2 cells keep emitting after division), not a biological slowdown; the true division-event doubling time is ~44 min.
simulations: 2-seed x 2-gen wild-type baseline ensemble (showcase2-baseline-full), Ray-parallel, XArray/zarr + parquet emit.
